newsitem.title: USA: First Federal Capital approves stock split.
newsitem.headline: First Federal Capital approves stock split.

text.p: First Federal Capital Corp said on Tuesday its board of directors approved a three-for-two stock split in the form of a common stock dividend.
The stock dividend is payable on June 12 to shareholders of record on May 15.

"The stock split, which will increase the number of shares outstanding and correspondingly reduce the stock's price, should broaden investor interest in the company and increase the liquidity of the company's shares," president and chief executive Thomas Schini said in a statement.
